title: specify epic progress counting semantics
description:
Epic progress counts are computed in display.rs (print_issue_list, print_issue_tree) from whatever issue slice the caller passes. Operations::list hands display a FILTERED slice, so with --status or --issue-type filters the (done/total) counts only include children matching the filter - a filtered view silently rewrites project progress. This is currently unspecified behavior, not a bug to silently fix.

Design questions:
1. Should epic counts always be computed over the FULL issue set regardless of list filters (progress is a property of the epic, not the view)? Proposed: yes.
2. Where do counts belong? Proposed: Operations returns them alongside issues (view-model boundary); display stays a pure formatter.
3. Do counts include proposed children or only todo/in_progress/done? Today: all non-filtered children count toward total, done counts toward done.
4. What about dangling part_of targets (deleted epics)?

Relevant code: src/display.rs print_issue_list epic_counts block; src/display.rs print_issue_tree epic_counts block; src/operations.rs list() filtered slice; SPEC r[issue-ordering]; bug pebble 'inconsistent epic child count display' covers only the (0) vs (0/1) format.
